_: THE PLANNER'S CHECKS (PlanCross, in the gate): journeys between continents and places, each planned over cross/links.json and transports.json with the app's own MultiHop, and what the plan must do. use: link ids it must take (r<path> a ride, f<a>><b> a flight, a links.json id, w:<a>><b> a walk); avoid: ids it must not take (above all a one-way link backwards); expect: "plan" (a chain is found), "none" (no chain: the planner says so), "gap" (a chain through a link with an end nobody has measured: it says which). flights: false plans without them (on foot and aboard only).
